title: Customer Service Advisor
description:
Looking for a customer service role where you can make a real difference and turn your experience into a permanent opportunity?
We're looking for a Customer Service Advisor to join a busy team based in Blackburn. This is a full-time temporary role with an immediate start and the opportunity to go permanent, paying 13.45 per hour.
With a variety of shifts available, this is a great opportunity for someone with previous call handling or customer service experience who enjoys helping people, resolving queries and making sure customers receive the support they need.
What will you be doing Customer Service Advisor?
- Answering incoming calls and responding to customer enquiries.
- Managing customer queries and helping to resolve issues efficiently.
- Providing clear information, guidance and reassurance to customers.
- Listening carefully to understand each customer's needs and concerns.
- Delivering a professional and helpful customer service experience.
- Recording relevant information accurately and keeping customer records up to date.
- Escalating incidents or more complex queries to the appropriate team when needed.
- Communicating clearly with colleagues to ensure queries are handled effectively.

What's in it for you?
- 13.45 per hour
- Full-time hours averaging 37.5 hours per week on a planned rota.
- Opportunity to go permanent and a chance to secure a longer-term position.
- Immediate start
- Variety of shifts a range of working patterns to suit the needs of the service.
- Valuable experience develop your customer service and communication skills in a busy call-handling environment.

Why would you join this company?
You'll be joining a team providing an important customer-facing service, where clear communication, reassurance and effective problem-solving make a real difference. If you enjoy speaking to people, helping them find solutions and working in a role where every call brings something different, this could be an excellent next step.
With the potential to move from temporary to permanent employment, it's also an opportunity to demonstrate your skills and build towards a longer-term position.
What we're looking for
What's essential:
- Previous call handling or customer service experience.
- Good verbal communication skills and a professional telephone manner.
- The ability to listen to customer queries and respond clearly and appropriately.
- Good organisational skills and attention to detail.
- The ability to record information accurately and recognise when an issue needs to be escalated.

What's helpful but not essential:
- Experience handling a high volume of calls.
- Experience dealing with customer complaints, sensitive enquiries or incidents.
- Previous experience working in a rota-based customer service environment.

The Essentials
- Salary: 13.45 per hour
- Hours: Full-time, averaging 37.5 hours per week on a planned rota. Shifts vary between 8:00 am and 10:00 pm and may include evenings, nights, weekends and public holidays, depending on the service requirements.
- Location: Blackburn
- Job type: Temporary, with the opportunity to go permanent
- Start date: Immediate

If you're looking for a Customer Service Advisor or Call Handler role offering an immediate start, competitive hourly pay and the opportunity to go permanent, we'd LOVE to hear from you!

title: Complaints Handler
salary_text: £27000 - £35000 per year (Private Health Ins., Free Parking)
description:
Looking for a great career move in customer services, helping customers resolve their concerns while making sure they receive the highest standard of service?

Based in modern offices in the centre of Blackburn, this is an opportunity to join a successful and expanding business as a Complaints Handler. You'll deal with customer complaints, queries and escalated issues, making sure each one is handled professionally, fairly and with the right level of care.

With a salary of up to 35,000 and an excellent benefits package, this role offers the chance to use your customer service and problem-solving skills in a professional, regulated environment, while developing your knowledge and building a genuine long-term career.

What will you be doing as a Complaints Handler?
- Handling customer complaints and escalated queries, making sure each matter is dealt with professionally and sensitively
- Speaking with customers by telephone and email to understand their concerns and provide solutions
- Managing a varied caseload, ensuring complaints are progressed and deadlines are met
- Investigating complaints, reviewing information and case records to establish what has happened and what action is needed
- Updating of customer records including interactions, actions taken and outcomes
- Working within company procedures and the standards expected within a regulated environment
- Identifying recurring issues and trends in complaints and customer feedback
- Working closely with colleagues across other teams to help maintain high standards of customer service

What's in it for you?
- A salary of 27,000 to 35,000, depending on experience
- 23 days' holiday plus bank holidays, increasing over time to 30 days
- An extra day off for your birthday
- The option to buy additional holidays
- Private healthcare after one year's service
- Pension scheme
- Life insurance worth three times your annual salary
- Bonus scheme based on company performance
- Long-service awards and milestone gifts
- Perkbox rewards scheme
- Company events
- Free on-site parking
- Wellbeing programme
- Rewards of up to 200 for suggestions that help improve the business
- Excellent opportunities for career development and professional qualifications

Why would you join this company?

You'll be joining a successful and expanding business where customer care, quality and compliance are important. As a Complaints Handler, you'll have the opportunity to make a real difference to customers, helping resolve their concerns while ensuring they receive a professional and positive experience.
It's a role where you'll be trusted to take ownership of your caseload and use your judgement, working closely with colleagues across the wider business. As the company continues to grow, there are also genuine opportunities to develop your skills and progress your career.
What we're looking for:
- What's essential:
- Previous experience handling customer complaints, escalations or complex customer queries
- Experience working in a customer service, claims or contact centre environment
- Confident communicating with customers by telephone and email
- A professional and empathetic approach when dealing with difficult or sensitive situations
- Strong verbal and written communication skills
- Good organisational skills and the ability to manage your own workload and caseload
- What's helpful but not essential:
- Experience within a legal, financial services or claims environment
- An awareness of SRA regulatory requirements and/or FCA Consumer Duty

The Essentials:

Salary: 27,000 to 35,000
Hours: 9am-5pm Monday to Friday (30 minutes lunch)
Location: Blackburn town centre
Job type: Permanent

If you're an experienced customer service professional who enjoys helping people, handling complaints and finding the right solutions, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Sales Administrator
description:
CareerMakers Recruitment are working with a well-established manufacturing business in Accrington who are looking to appoint an experienced Sales Administrator to support their busy commercial team.

This is a varied position combining sales administration with account management responsibilities. You will act as a key point of contact for customers, ensuring a smooth process from enquiry through to delivery, while building strong, long-term relationships.

The Role

As Sales Administrator, you will provide comprehensive support to the sales function while taking ownership to ensure full compliance with UK regulations. You will act as a central link between sales, purchasing, production, and external regulatory bodies.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage a portfolio of customer accounts, acting as the main point of contact
- Process sales orders accurately and efficiently
- Prepare and follow up on quotations
- Liaise with production, logistics, and procurement teams to ensure timely delivery
- Handle customer enquiries, resolving issues promptly and professionally
- Maintain accurate records on CRM/ERP systems
- Support external sales managers with customer updates and reporting
- Monitor stock levels and delivery schedules

Systems & Stock Management
- Develop working knowledge of the MRP system (currently using 123 Insight)
- Assist with stock level monitoring based on sales forecasts and customer demand
- Support cross-departmental communication between sales, engineering, and operations

General Office Support
- Assist with ad hoc administrative duties
- Provide support to engineering when required
- Coordinate with contractors regarding repairs and maintenance

Qualifications/Experience
- Excellent communicator
- Proactive and a team player
- Understanding on how to use Excel, Word, PowerPoint
- Excellent organisational skills
- Relevant experience within an SME manufacturing facility preferred
- Previous experience in a sales/administrator role

About You

We are looking for a confident and detail-oriented professional who can take ownership of export compliance responsibilities.

You will have:
- Previous experience in a sales administration, internal sales, or account management role
- Experience within manufacturing, engineering, or a product-based environment preferred
- Strong organisational and multitasking skills
- Excellent communication and customer service abilities
- Good IT skills (Excel, CRM/ERP systems such as SAP or Salesforce desirable)
- Proactive and able to work both independently and as part of a team

title: Receptionist
description: We are looking for 2 motivated and dynamic medical receptionists, preferably with previous experience to cover 45 hours in total (1 full time, 1 part time or job share considered) to join the team at St James Medical Centre. We are based in leafy Rawtenstall, close to good motorway links. Previous General Practice experience is preferred but training will be given. As part of the admin team the successful candidate will be responsible for greeting patients and arriving them on the clinical system, dealing with queries and appointment requests both in person and by telephone and text message . The practice aims to have staff that are multi skilled and staff will broaden skills, learning to perform other admin functions. The practice is often very busy and therefore resilience and flexibility are required along with excellent communication skills. Answering telephone calls, texts and online request for queries and appointments. Signposting patients to the most appropriate staff or service. Liaising with clinical staff, updating systems, dealing with incoming and outgoing correspondence, processing repeat prescriptions. Supporting colleagues to deal with the daily workload and providing cover as needed where possible. Safeguarding Children and Adults The organisation has a zero tolerance approach to the abuse of children, young people and vulnerable adults. All employees are required to promote and safeguard the welfare of children and young people and comply with the Local Safeguarding Children Board Procedures and the Children Act (1989, 2004). In accordance with the CCG and Local Safeguarding Adult Board policy all staff must ensure the health and wellbeing of vulnerable adults is appropriately safeguarded. All staff are required to attend training appropriate to their role in safeguarding children and adults, which includes understanding and recognising the signs of abuse and knowing how to raise concerns when those signs of abuse are noticed in a person .

title: Receptionist
description: We are looking to find the perfect fit to join the reception team at our GP Practice. The role of the GP Receptionist is fast-paced, and can at times be very demanding, so we are looking for an individual who is confident and resilient; with a professional attitude and an empathetic manner. Excellent communication and IT skills are essential, and candidates must be highly organised and also good at multi-tasking. Previous experience in a General Practice or healthcare setting is desirable, but not essential as training will be provided. The position is part time, working 27.75 hours over three days Processing in person, telephone and online requests for appointments, visits and telephone consultations and ensuring patients are directed to the appropriate healthcare professional. Computer data entry/data allocation and collation; processing and recording information in accordance with practice procedures. Providing clerical assistance to practice staff, including word/data processing, filing, photocopying and scanning. To act on patient requests with respect, sympathy and confidentiality. To deal with frustrated or upset patients in a professional manner, and to respond to any unpredictable situation that may arise. The Receptionist will be responsible for undertaking a wide range of reception duties and the provision of general support to the multidisciplinary team. Duties can include, but are not limited to, greeting and directing patients, the effective use of the appointment system, booking appointments, the processing of information (electronic and hard copy) in a timely manner and in accordance with current policies, assisting patients as required and supporting the administration team with patient registration. The post-holder will act as the central point of contact for patients, be responsible for the distribution of information, messages and enquiries for the clinical team, liaise with multi-disciplinary team members and external agencies such as secondary care and community service providers. The Receptionist will support staff with the distribution of information, messages and enquiries for the clinical team, liaising with multidisciplinary team members and external agencies such as secondary care and community service providers. The post-holder will be an integral part of the general practice team. Please see the attached job description for further detail.
